scope: 500-headword static Korean sense lexicon proof of concept

source.name: Open English WordNet
source.canonical_identifier: OEWN sense key (sense_id), with synset_id and ILI retained

selection.policy: Common content words plus explicit polysemy and learner-reading buckets; proper-name-heavy 2025 Plus data was not used.
selection.sense_policy: Every OEWN sense attached to each exact selected headword is included without truncation.

korean.status: Breeze PoC editorial layer; not an official OEWN translation
korean.draft_method: Local English-to-Korean machine-translation draft from each OEWN definition, followed by a higher-quality local model pass for 818 senses, structural QA, and targeted manual corrections; no user data or remote inference API

draft_models.name: translate-studio/MiLMMT-46-4B-v1.0-5bit-MLX
draft_models.coverage: 818 upgraded definition drafts, including every run/set/get/take/charge sense

korean.known_issue: All 5,715 senses are populated and structurally distinct, but only targeted polysemy samples and validation outliers received manual correction. Many non-core senses still contain literal or awkward machine-translated wording and require native-speaker line-by-line editorial review before production use.
